violations.text: Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the front service area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

Raw animal foods (such as raw beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cooked chicken) in the reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Items were replaced during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils of the slicer were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

Pernil, Salmon and Chicken were observed held at 116-123 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed and reheated during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

Small amounts of water were observed on the floor in the basement (raining at onset and prior to inspection). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2026
Food prep sink is lacking an air gap. Food prep sink currently has an air break. New Violation. Correct By: 05/08/2026
